text: The SHIELD Programme is unique in its multi-stakeholder approach, involving a consortium of international, public, and private organizations. It emphasizes the integration of scientific data into local planning and decision-making processes, and it aims to unlock funding for resilience actions at the local government level. The programme also includes a dedicated SHIELD Support Unit for monitoring, evaluation, and partnership brokering.

metadata.solution_name: Strengthening Institutions and Empowering Localities Against Disasters and Climate Change in the Philippines (SHIELD Programme)
